rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.workflow`.

The requirement says the skill must open with its workflow as ordered steps, before any other section. The file does this:

- After the front matter comes the `# Habeas requirements` title. Under it is a short two-sentence preamble, which is not a section. It says that observable results must follow from an agreed requirement and points to the habeas skill for syntax.
- The first `##` section is `## Workflow`. The other sections, `## Writing chapters`, `## Choosing references`, `## What the review checks` and `## Gotchas`, all come after it.
- `## Workflow` is a numbered list of steps 1 to 7, each written as a checkbox item (`- [ ] 1.` through `- [ ] 7.`). These are ordered steps, from checking the starting point through to authoring evidence.
- Text after the list covers when to revisit earlier steps. It is part of the workflow section, not a separate section placed before it.

The requirement states no other obligation for its sites, and I found no gap. The task named no violation matches to judge.
